title: Add Elementor bridge templates for filter presets
description: Create a Simple Budget-style Elementor template bridge for filter presets so presets can be edited visually in Elementor instead of becoming a confusing admin builder.
objective: Let an implementer create a plugin-owned Elementor template from a filter preset, open it in Elementor, and keep the preset selected in the Filter Controller starter widget.
expected_outputs: Filter Presets admin shows a clear Elementor bridge panel.
Existing presets can create Elementor templates owned by the plugin.
Template rows can be edited in Elementor or deleted with nonce and ownership checks.
Starter template contains the Filter Controller configured to consume the selected preset.
acceptance_criteria: Template creation requires manage_options and a nonce.
Template manager verifies Elementor availability before creating templates.
Created templates are elementor_library posts tagged with EIT role and preset metadata.
Edit links route to Elementor's edit URL when available.
Delete action validates ownership and delete_post capability.
verification: WP-CLI smoke creates a template for a preset when Elementor is available.
WP-CLI smoke verifies ownership metadata and starter widget settings.
MCP validate_task for TASK-014 returned valid.
WP-CLI smoke created a plugin-owned Elementor template from a preset and verified role/preset metadata.

budgets.context_budget: FilterPresetAdmin plus one template helper class
budgets.research_budget: reuse local Simple Budget pattern only
budgets.scope_budget: admin bridge and starter template only
budgets.validation_budget: MCP plus WP-CLI smoke plus lint

risks: Elementor may be inactive in a target site, so admin must show a warning and fail safely.
This does not register Elementor Pro Theme Builder conditions.
Template starter data can drift if Elementor changes document APIs.
